meta.name: get-qodo-rules
meta.description: Loads org- and repo-level coding rules from Qodo before code tasks begin, ensuring all generation and modification follows team standards. Use before any code generation or modification task when rules are not already loaded. Invoke when user asks to write, edit, refactor, or review code, or when starting implementation planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 加载团队编码规则，确保代码符合规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队有编码规则需要自动遵守
copy.tagline_en: Load team coding rules to ensure code compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team has coding rules to enforce automatically

howto.what: 在写或改代码前，Claude 会先检查是否已加载 Qodo 规则；若未加载，会从 Qodo 拉取本仓库的编码规则（安全、标准、质量、约定），按严重级别展示，并据此生成代码，对强制规则加注释。
howto.when: 当用户要求写、编辑、重构或审查代码，或开始规划实现，且 Qodo 规则尚未加载时触发。若上下文已有“Qodo Rules Loaded”，则跳过。

say.text: 开始写代码前，先帮我加载 Qodo 规则。
say.note: Claude 会检查并拉取规则，然后继续编码任务。

say.text: 请获取这个仓库的 Qodo 编码规则。
say.note: Claude 将从 Qodo 拉取并按严重级别展示规则。

say.text: 实现这个功能前，先加载团队编码规范。
say.note: 确保代码符合 ERROR 级规则，并加注释。

howto.what_en: Before coding, Claude checks if Qodo rules are loaded; if not, it fetches repo rules (security, standards, quality, conventions) from Qodo, shows them by severity, and follows them, adding comments for ERROR rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write, edit, refactor, or review code, or starts implementation planning, provided rules are not already loaded. Skipped if 'Qodo Rules Loaded' is in context.

say_en.text: Load Qodo rules before writing code.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and display rules, then continue coding.

say_en.text: Fetch the Qodo coding rules for this repo.
say_en.note: Claude retrieves rules and shows them by severity.

say_en.text: Load team coding standards before implementing this.
say_en.note: Ensures compliance with ERROR rules, with comments.
